science.title: Why athletes love beets
science.text: Beetroot is one of nature's richest sources of dietary nitrates — which your body converts into nitric oxide, the molecule that relaxes and widens blood vessels. That's why beets are linked with healthy blood pressure, better circulation and improved stamina. We pack 1,300 mg of organic beetroot into two clean capsules, so you get the benefit without juicing.
